652214: hung parliament in parliamentary system of government hung parliament is expression used to describe state of parliament when no single political party or bloc of allied parties has absolute majority of seats in parliament legislature and therefore has no legitimate mandate to form government it is also less commonly known as balanced parliament or legislature under no overall control if legislature is bicameral and government is responsible only to lower house then hung parliament is used only with respect to that chamber it is objective of parliamentary systems for parliament to be able to form stable government preferably one that lasts until next election this requires government to be able to muster up sufficient votes in parliament to pass important legislation especially government s budget it also needs sufficient votes to defeat votes of no confidence in government if state of parliament is such that majority government cannot be formed government may be referred to as minority government term hung parliament is used mainly in systems with two parties or two party blocs most general elections in such system will result in one or other party having absolute majority and thus quickly forming new government hung parliament is exception to this pattern and may by some be considered anomalous or undesirable and by others ideal as it blocks dangers of absolute power one or both main parties may seek to form coalition government with smaller third parties or minority government relying on confidence and supply support from third parties or independents if these efforts fail dissolution of parliament and fresh election may be last resort

791546: ketogenic diet ketogenic diet is high fat adequate protein low carbohydrate diet that in medicine is used primarily to treat difficult to control refractory epilepsy in children diet forces body to burn fats rather than carbohydrates normally carbohydrates contained in food are converted into glucose which is then transported around body and is particularly important in fueling brain function however if there is very little carbohydrate in diet liver converts fat into fatty acids and ketone bodies ketone bodies pass into brain and replace glucose as energy source elevated level of ketone bodies in blood state known as ketosis leads to reduction in frequency of epileptic seizures almost half of children and young people with epilepsy who have tried some form of this diet saw number of seizures drop by at least half and effect persists even after discontinuing diet there is some evidence that adults with epilepsy may benefit from diet and that less strict regimen such as modified atkins diet is similarly effective most common adverse effect is constipation affecting about 30 of patients this was due to fluid restriction which was once feature of diet but this led to increased risk of kidney stones and is no longer considered beneficial

5181815: cinema of pakistan cinema of pakistan or pakistani cinema urdu refers to filmmaking industry in pakistan pakistan is home to several film studios centres primarily located in its two largest cities karachi and lahore pakistani cinema has played important part in pakistani culture and in recent years has begun flourishing again after years of decline delivering entertainment to audiences in pakistan and expatriates abroad several film industries are based in pakistan which tend to be regional and niche in nature over 10 000 urdu feature films have been produced in pakistan since 1948 as well as over 8000 punjabi 6000 pashto and 2000 sindhi feature length films first film ever produced was husn ka daku in 1930 directed by abdur rashid kardar in lahore first pakistani film produced was teri yaad directed by daud chand in 1948 between 1947 and 2007 pakistani cinema was based in lahore home to nation s largest film industry nicknamed lollywood pakistani films during this period attracted large audiences and had strong cult following was part of cultural mainstream widely available and imitated by masses during early 1970s pakistan was world s fourth largest producer of feature films however between 1977 and 2007 film industry of pakistan went into decline due to islamization strengthening of censorship laws and overall lack of quality throughout 1980s and 1990s film industry went through several periods of ups and downs reflection of its dependency on state funding and incentives by 2000 film industry in lahore had collapsed and saw gradual shift of pakistani actors actresses producers and filmmakers from lahore to karachi by 2007 wounds of pakistan s collapsed film industry began to heal and karachi had cemented itself as centre of pakistani cinema quality and new technology led to explosion of alternative form of pakistani cinema shift has been seen by many as leading cause for resurgence of pakistani cinema despite industry crisis starting in mid 1980s pakistani films have retained much of its distinctive identity since shift to karachi pakistani films have once again began attracting strong cult following

52360458: national liberal party romania 1875 national liberal party romanian partidul național liberal pnl was first organised political party in romania major force in country s politics from its foundation in 1875 to world war ii established in order to represent interests of nascent local bourgeoisie until world war i it contested power with conservative party supported primarily by wealthy landowners effectively creating two party system in political system which severely limited representation of peasant majority through census suffrage unlike its major opponent pnl managed to preserve its prominence after implementation of universal male suffrage playing important role in shaping institutional framework of greater romania during 1920s though initially opposed to restoration of deposed king carol ii it became increasingly supportive of his authoritarian policies with pnl governments paving way to royal dictatorship in late 1930s formally disbanded along all political parties in 1938 party structures were preserved unofficially with many party members also enlisting in carol s national renaissance front tolerated by totalitarian government of ion antonescu it eventually joined king michael i and communist national peasants and social democratic parties in overthrowing dictator in closing phase of world war ii enabling reorganisation of party in 1944 part of first post war grand coalition governments it lost its importance as new communist led coalition government used denazification process in order to remove pnl supporters from government posts with communist dominated government gaining upper hand in local politics and starting to crack down on opposition party decided to cease political activity in late 1940s effectively disbanding itself after overthrow of communist party rule in 1989 new party was founded under same name and assumed national liberal legacy
